summary: The frames are nearly static, with the head tilted up and the mouth barely open until a sudden jaw drop at 8.00, and the shot's ahh gag is not yet visible in this strip.

faults.what: From 7.76 to 7.96 he is almost frozen: head, shoulders and closed mouth barely change for about 7 frames, so he reads as a stiff, mushy hold with no anticipation or eye/head life before the ahh.
faults.fix: Add a small anticipation (breath-in, head dip or eye flick) before the jaw opens, or add a subtle head drift.

faults.what: At 8.00 the mouth snaps from closed (7.96) to open with teeth showing in a single frame, and the head angle shifts slightly. There is no in-between or anticipation, so it reads as a pose snap rather than a jaw drop.
faults.fix: Add 2-3 in-between frames with anticipation, then overshoot the jaw and settle.
